fit: flavonoid-rich cocoa in a rice beverage and fatigue in Parkinson disease
assessment: The pilot measured fatigue and fatigability after high- versus low-flavonoid cocoa beverages. The study gives no plain dark chocolate contrast or speech intelligibility estimate.

fit: cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil combined with Solcoseryl for cancer-treatment oral mucositis
assessment: The matching 2024 paper reports lower aggregate PROMS with a topical combination containing 10% cold-pressed oil versus benzydamine. A mouth-pain item is part of the scale and was not reported separately. Solcoseryl and the adverse comparator prevent isolated attribution.

fit: oral peanut oil placebo and planned falls in a sarcopenia trial family
assessment: TEMPUS-FUGIT specifies a 1 g peanut-oil placebo and planned falls surveillance. Published ENHANce feasibility results and accessible publisher supplement cover mobility and sarcopenia measures without a verified arm-specific falls estimate. Parkinson disease was excluded and refining was unreported.
